headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: EBITDA grew 14.5% YoY to INR 10,222 cr, while EBITDA margin stood at 17.8%, compared with 19.4% in Q2FY26.
Raw material costs rose to 64.6% of revenue from 61.0%, partly offset by lower employee and other expenses as a share of revenue.
PAT increased 34.4% YoY to INR 4,697 cr, with PAT margin improving to 8.2% from 7.6%.
Net profit rose 24.9% to INR 4,588 cr, while net margin was steady at 8.0%.
